steps.en: Install the CLI in an isolated environment and create a palace
steps.zh: 在隔离环境装好 CLI，并建一个 palace
steps.code: uv tool install mempalace · mempalace init ~/projects/myapp

steps.zh: 把已有的 Claude Code 会话记录回填进去

steps.en: Stores chunks verbatim under wings and rooms, with embeddings and closet pointers
steps.zh: 按 wing 和 room 原文存块，并写入向量和 closet 指针

steps.en: Register the MCP server and auto-save hooks in your agent
steps.zh: 在 agent 里注册 MCP 服务器和自动保存 hook

steps.en: Files new turns every 15 messages and before compaction
steps.zh: 每 15 条消息和压缩上下文前自动归档新对话

steps.en: Answers search calls with verbatim passages ranked by vector plus BM25
steps.zh: 按向量加 BM25 排序，返回原文段落

value.en: Your agent gets the original words back instead of a paraphrase, without re-explaining past sessions
value.zh: agent 拿回的是原话而不是转述，不用再重讲过去的会话
